plugins.name: find-duplicates
plugins.title: Find Duplicates
plugins.description: Lists files that share an exact size, usually the same book stored twice. Reads only the folder listing and changes nothing.

plugins.name: metadata-editor
plugins.title: Metadata Editor
plugins.description: Corrects a book's title, author, series and description, and sets its cover, in files beside the book. The book itself is not changed.

plugins.name: organize-by-author
plugins.title: Organize by Author
plugins.description: Sorts the EPUBs of one folder into a folder per author, taking their cover and metadata files along. Shows a preview first.
